component.name: VibeRadio
component.summary: Internet radio with recording and wishlists

description.p: VibeRadio is a native internet-radio client for Linux. It plays radio, keeps a searchable station library, records songs as separate files, identifies them with Chromaprint and AcoustID, builds a clean verified music tree, and watches stations for wishlist songs.

ul.li: Import stations from radio.net and radio-browser
Split recordings per song with live and scheduled boundaries
Fingerprint and identify recordings, with tagged verified copies
Wishlist rules, watched stations and a rolling pre-roll buffer
Favorites, sessions, schedules, mini player, tray and MPRIS
